title: Flash Video (FLV) signature
summary: An FLV file begins with the 3-byte signature 'FLV' (0x46 0x4C 0x56) followed by 0x01 (version 1) and a 4-byte flags field (audio/video presence).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: FLV is a container format for audio/video used by Flash Player.
FLV uses AMF (Action Message Format) for metadata.
Largely superseded by MP4 and WebM.
